traditions.KJV: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him ,

traditions.KJV: and the cords that [ were ] upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן בִּ לְחִ֣י הַ חֲמ֔וֹר חֲמ֖וֹר חֲמֹרָתָ֑יִם

traditions.WLC: בִּ לְחִ֣י הַ חֲמ֔וֹר הִכֵּ֖יתִי אֶ֥לֶף אִֽישׁ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐν τῇ σιαγόνι τοῦ ὄνου ἐπάταξα χιλίους ἄνδρας .
traditions.KJV: with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men .

traditions.KJV: And he was sore athirst , and called on the LORD ,

traditions.KJV: and said , Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant :

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּה֙ אָמ֣וּת בַּ צָּמָ֔א וְ נָפַלְתִּ֖י בְּ יַ֥ד הָ עֲרֵלִֽים

traditions.KJV: and now shall I die for thirst , and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised ?
